# GUI Update — Possible Same-Series Grouping

This updates `cbz_gui.py` so the **Series Organizer** can run the new possible same-series grouping workflow.

New GUI options under **Series Organizer**:

- `Move likely same-series folders to _Check`
- `Common title words`
- `Minimum group size`

When enabled, the GUI adds:

```powershell
--possible-series-check --series-common-words N --series-min-group-size N
```

to the `cbz_library_maintenance.py organize-series` command.

## Example command generated by the GUI

```powershell
python scripts\cbz_library_maintenance.py organize-series "\\tower\media\comics\Comix" --dry-run --workers 8 --possible-series-check --series-common-words 2 --series-min-group-size 2
```

## Commit

```powershell
git add cbz_gui.py
git commit -m "feat(gui): expose possible same-series grouping option"
```
